bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) dataset, measuring the model's ability to avoid relying on stereotypes across various demographic roles (e.g., age, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, race, and ethnicity) by aggregating multi-role reasoning paths.
Evaluating divergent accuracy on the GlobalOpinionQA dataset by generating answers from the perspective of different nationalities and comparing them to country-specific survey ground truths.
Evaluating role-dependent reasoning on the CALI (Culturally Aware Natural Language Inference) dataset by comparing the model's cultural perspective outputs to culturally specific ground truths.
